mainEntity.name: What types of insulation are available for home upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common insulation types for home upgrades include fiberglass batts, blown-in cellulose, spray foam, and rigid foam boards. Each type offers different R-values, installation methods, and suitability for various areas of a home, such as attics, walls, or crawl spaces. We can help assess which material best fits your home's structure and energy goals in areas like Berkeley or Albany.
